title: ui: main's Test UI (9/16) is red since #26786. The actionKeys pin lists every spec ActionSchema key, and `SPEC_ACTION_KEYS` lacks the new `disabledReason`
body:
## Source

The ui seat found this while reading two card PRs' reds (PR #26821 Test UI 5/16 and PR #26824 Test UI 15/16, both 18:24Z). It then checked `origin/main`: main's own push run at `aeb9cf0d` has Test UI (9/16) red on the same assertion ([job](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/40557445199/job/122378348347)).

## Problem

PR #26786 merged at `13dc413f` (18:09Z). It is part 1 of #26619 and adds `disabledReason` to `ActionSchema` in `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts`. `ui/packages/core/src/actions/__tests__/actionKeys.pin.test.ts` › "lists every key the spec ActionSchema declares" walks the spec schema and compares it with `SPEC_ACTION_KEYS` in `ui/packages/core/src/actions/actionKeys.ts`. The array has no `disabledReason`, so every Test UI run on main or on a PR merged with main fails:

```
AssertionError: expected { missing: [ 'disabledReason' ], …(1) } to deeply equal { missing: [], stale: [] }
 ❯ packages/core/src/actions/__tests__/actionKeys.pin.test.ts:140:32
```

`classifyActionKeys` reads `KNOWN_ACTION_KEYS`, which includes `SPEC_ACTION_KEYS`. Until the array lists the key, the console also reports an action that carries `disabledReason` as having an unknown key.

## Target

Add `'disabledReason'` to `SPEC_ACTION_KEYS`, after `'disabled'`, with a comment of the kind `'description'` has. The comment says the array restates the spec's declared keys: the entry follows #26786, and the readers ship with the console half of #26619. `ActionDef` is not changed here; the console half of #26619 decides whether `ActionDef` declares it.

## File surface

`ui/packages/core/src/actions/actionKeys.ts` (one entry and its comment), one changeset (`@object-ui/core` patch). No `packages/spec/**` change, no new key.

## Acceptance

`pnpm --filter @object-ui/core exec vitest run src/actions/__tests__/actionKeys` is green. Main's Test UI shards are green after the merge.

Related: #26619, PR #26786.
